stories.title: Estonia Accuses Russia of Orchestrating Arson Attack on Defense Company
stories.summary: Estonia has accused Russia of orchestrating an arson attack on Milrem Robotics, a defense company that supplies unmanned vehicles to Ukraine. The attack, which occurred in mid-August, is described by Estonian officials as an act of sabotage commissioned by Russian security services. This allegation has drawn support from European and NATO leaders, who condemned the attack as unacceptable.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy's Defense Challenges Evidence in Murder Case
stories.summary: Lindsay Clancy returned to court for the first time since her murder trial ended in a mistrial. Her attorney argued that the prosecution failed to provide sufficient evidence to prove she killed her three children. This marks a significant shift in the defense's strategy, which previously focused on her mental state during the trial. A hearing has been set for November to discuss the possibility of a retrial.

The incident occurred shortly after takeoff from the Ukrainka air base, which had been used to shelter aircraft following significant damage from Ukraine's Operation Spiderweb in June 2025.

stories.title: Tennessee Governor Allows Execution of Christa Pike, the State's Only Woman on Death Row
stories.summary: Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has decided not to halt the execution of Christa Pike, who is currently the only woman on death row in the state. If carried out, Pike's execution would mark the first time a woman has been executed in Tennessee in over 200 years. Pike, now 50, was involved in a murder at the age of 18.
